policy.what_happened: Final regulations provide guidance for automatic enrollment requirements that apply to certain retirement plans.
policy.effect: Your retirement plan participation is subject to new automatic enrollment requirements starting January 19, 2027.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: A mathematician working for artificial intelligence company Anthropic claims to have solved a major mathematical problem, the second such claim linked to an AI company in recent months.
Google is rolling out a redesigned search homepage that integrates AI chat history and removes the traditional search button, making AI tools more accessible directly on the search page.
A researcher demonstrated that unique, trackable secrets inserted into AI prompts can expose secret user data at an alarming rate, revealing privacy vulnerabilities within the AI supply chain.

world.summary: Two tankers were reportedly hit in the Strait of Hormuz near Oman, while Iran stated one tanker caught fire due to a naval mine, as Iran reportedly tightens its grip on shipping in the area.
International climate talks at COP31 are in a deadlock as countries struggle to agree on a new global climate agreement due to disagreements over fossil fuels.

U.N. talks in Geneva concluded without achieving legally binding rules on autonomous weapons, prompting humanitarian groups to express concern that military AI is advancing faster than diplomatic efforts.
Denmark is expelling a Russian diplomat, Russia's defense attache in Copenhagen, following suspicions that Moscow was involved in an attempted killing of a US-Ukrainian rapper.

us.summary: A federal jury in Los Angeles convicted 30-year-old Jonathan Rinderknecht of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire, which resulted in 12 fatalities, following a retrial.
Hackers reportedly breached the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the FBI, targeting the farmer-payment system at the USDA and the FBI's National Crime Information Center.

A report to the US Congress found that the US Navy's commitment to new "Trump-class" battleships has inflated the cost of its new fleet by billions of dollars, with the acting Secretary of the Navy admitting the Iran war is straining fleet capacity.

science.summary: Scientists successfully sequenced the entire genome of a whale by using commercial drones equipped with petri dishes to collect samples of the whale's snot, demonstrating a novel genetic research method.

A daily pill called daraxonrasib has shown "massive hope" for pancreatic cancer treatment, with a trial indicating it can shrink and potentially eliminate tumors in some patients with this aggressive cancer.
